title: slugify splits plural acronyms like APIs
description: Plural acronyms are split into two words. A lowercase `s` after an acronym is a plural, not the start of a new word: `slugify('APIs')` should return `apis` and `slugify('Util APIs')` should return `util-apis`. An acronym followed by a capitalised word must still be split (`APISection` is `api-section`).
notes: SWE-bench-style. base_ref is the upstream fix's parent; hidden/test.js is the upstream test file at fix_commit. The scratch repo must hold base_ref's history only (bench/factory/README.md, 'Scratch repositories').
